name: Pull-Up (Neutral Grip, Weighted)
instructions: Attach a weight belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hang from neutral-grip handles with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades down and then pull your chest toward the handles.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A weighted neutral-grip pull-up for advanced upper-body pulling strength.

commonMistakes: Loading before you have strict bodyweight reps
safetyNotes: Build strict bodyweight reps first; stop with elbow or shoulder pain.
